info.name: Incident Management - flows
info.description:
Two end-to-end flows; run each folder top to bottom with the Collection Runner (every request has tests). Start the app with the seed profile first (see README). Users are sent by username in X-User-Id ({{bob}} = bob); {{bobId}} etc. hold their ids for checks. Folders are independent and can be re-run: each creates its own incidents.

1. Reporter (Bob, no team): report, follow and edit his incident; what a reporter may not do.
2. Team member (Dan, Database team): queue, acknowledge, severity, escalate / de-escalate, review, resolve, reopen, close, hand-over, reassign, cancel.
